description_en: Lists the features available to the current user account on Alibaba Cloud Link WAN
description_zh: 列举当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台所能使用的功能
name: ListActivatedFeatures

parameters.help_en: The current calling environment. Leave this parameter empty by default to indicate the public instance. If the environment is an IoT Platform instantiated environment, set this parameter to "IotInstance"
parameters.help_zh: 当前的调用环境，默认为空，表示公共实例，如果是物联网平台实例化环境，请传入“IotInstance”
parameters.name: environment

items.description_en:
The list of features available to the current user account on Alibaba Cloud Link WAN. Valid values:

    GATEWAY_TUPLE: gateway key management feature

    NODE_TUPLE: node key management feature

    NODE: node management feature

    GATEWAY: gateway management feature

    LOCAL_JOIN_PERMISSION: local credential management feature

    ROAMING_JOIN_PERMISSION: roaming credential management feature

    JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTHORIZATION: credential permission granting feature

    LAB_NODE: lab node feature

    LAB_GATEWAY: lab gateway feature

    NOTIFICATION: notification feature

    UNICAST: unicast instruction downlink feature

    MULTICAST: multicast instruction downlink feature

    RELAY: relay management feature

    D2D: peer-to-peer communication feature
items.description_zh:
当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台所能使用的功能的列表。

    GATEWAY_TUPLE：网关密钥管理功能

    NODE_TUPLE：节点密钥管理功能

    NODE：节点管理功能

    GATEWAY：网关管理功能

    LOCAL_JOIN_PERMISSION：本地凭证管理功能

    ROAMING_JOIN_PERMISSION：漫游凭证管理功能

    JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTHORIZATION：凭证权限授受能力

    LAB_NODE：实验室节点功能

    LAB_GATEWAY：实验室网关功能

    NOTIFICATION：通知功能

    UNICAST：单播指令下行功能

    MULTICAST：组播指令下行功能

    RELAY：中继管理功能

    D2D：点对点通信能力

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
